review: independent Form intrinsic field sizing review

review_findings.detail: Policy is opt-in and defaults Fixed. Existing field kinds retain fixed sizing; chooser intrinsic behavior is gated by Intrinsic. Placement height consumes live FormData for flat and lane planning and is reused by measure/update/draw.

Note rows use supplied semantic roles in Intrinsic mode, size follows live row count, and source window skips clipped rows. Tests cover 0/1/5 rows, following-field placement, color tones and partial scroll.

Intrinsic chooser is display-only: value and optional detail are rendered before a real shared trailing Button. Tests assert the value has no hit target and button click produces Chose(field ID). Unicode/narrow widths are covered.

No explicit intrinsic chooser measurement assertion or intrinsic lane-layout contract test was found. Existing shared placement path is used for both; this is not a demonstrated functional defect, but those combinations remain unproven.

The 60x30 before/after signature is one default chooser scenario, not a full frozen visual application comparison. This WIP has not migrated an application FormDialog; its own audit correctly marks adoption/parity pending.
